texts:
This is the documentation, rebuilt as a place. More than 300 pages, and you read them by walking up to them.

Every docs section is a pavilion on a ring, 16 in all. Search a page from wherever you stand and a trail of arrows leads to the pavilion that holds it. Enter reads it there and then: the real page opens inside the scene, as text you can select and zoom.

three.ws/docs/world
Same files as the classic docs, so the two can never drift apart. Walk with the arrow keys or the touch joystick, and pass any rigged GLB with ?avatar= to make it your body in the world.
